desc: claimkeeper is published to npm as `claimkeeper`, so `npx -y claimkeeper` and `npm install -g claimkeeper` work in any project; the plugin and a git checkout keep running from plugin/dist/cli.js.

history.desc: claimkeeper is not published to npm yet, so `npx claimkeeper` is not available in other projects; the CLI runs from a checkout (plugin/dist/cli.js) until it is published.
claimkeeper is published to npm as `claimkeeper`, so `npx -y claimkeeper` and `npm install -g claimkeeper` work in any project; the plugin and a git checkout keep running from plugin/dist/cli.js.

mentions.anchor: Install from npm with `npm install -g claimkeeper` (or run one command with `npx -y claimkeeper <command>`); from a checkout use `node <checkout>/plugin/dist/cli.js`.
